title.zh: 卷176 表十六 军机大臣年表一
title.en: Volume 176 Tables 16: Grand Councilors Chronological Table 1
title.raw: 卷176 表十六 军机大臣年表一

sentences.zh: 軍機處名不師古，而絲綸出納，職居密勿。

translations.literal: The Grand Council's name follows no ancient model, yet it handles the receipt and dispatch of imperial rescripts, and its duties are among the most confidential.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Council had no ancient precedent for its name, yet it controlled the flow of imperial edicts and its work was among the most secret in the realm.

sentences.zh: 初祗秉廟謨商戎略而已，厥後軍國大計，罔不總攬。

translations.literal: At first it only carried out the emperor's plans and discussed military strategy; afterward all major state and military affairs were gathered under its charge.
translations.idiomatic: At first it merely executed the emperor's designs and deliberated on military strategy; later it took charge of every major affair of state and war.

sentences.zh: 自雍、乾後百八十年，威命所寄，不於內閣而於軍機處，盖隱然执政之府矣。

translations.literal: For one hundred and eighty years after Yongzheng and Qianlong, the seat of imperial authority rested not in the Grand Secretariat but in the Grand Council — it was in effect the hidden seat of power.
translations.idiomatic: For the hundred and eighty years after Yongzheng and Qianlong, real authority rested not with the Grand Secretariat but with the Grand Council — in effect, the hidden seat of government.

sentences.zh: 今詳著其人，庶後之考心腹股肱之佐，而究其時政化隆污消長之跡者，以覽觀焉。

translations.literal: Now their names are set forth in detail, so that later readers who examine the emperor's closest ministers and trace the rise and decline of the age's political fortunes may consult this record.
translations.idiomatic: Their names are now recorded in full, so that later readers who study the emperor's closest advisers and trace how the times rose, fell, and changed may consult this table.

translations.literal: Here is compiled a table of Grand Council ministers.
translations.idiomatic: A table of Grand Council ministers.
